-- 1. Create an External Data Source pointing to your Silver container
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.external_data_sources WHERE name = 'SilverData')
BEGIN
    CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE SilverData
    WITH (
        LOCATION = 'https://advwprojectstorage.blob.core.windows.net/silver'
    );
END;
GO

-- ==================================================
-- 3. Views (Dimension & Fact Layers)
-- ==================================================

-- Customer
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW Dim_Customer AS
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'customer/',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'SilverData',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS [Customer];
GO

-- Product
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW Dim_Product AS
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'product/',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'SilverData',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS [Product];
GO

-- Product Category
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW Dim_ProductCategory AS
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'productcategory/',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'SilverData',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS [ProductCat];
GO

-- Product SubCategory
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW Dim_ProductSubCategory AS
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'productsubcategory/',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'SilverData',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS [ProductSubCat];
GO

-- Territories
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW Dim_Territories AS
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'territories/',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'SilverData',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS [Territories];
GO

-- Calendar
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW Dim_Calendar AS
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'calender/',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'SilverData',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS [Calendar];
GO

-- Returns
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW Fact_Returns AS
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'returns/',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'SilverData',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS [Returns];
GO

-- Unified Sales Fact View (Combines 2015, 2016, 2017)
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW Fact_Sales AS
SELECT *, 2015 AS SalesYear FROM OPENROWSET(BULK 'sales2015/', DATA_SOURCE = 'SilverData', FORMAT = 'PARQUET') AS [S15]
UNION ALL
SELECT *, 2016 AS SalesYear FROM OPENROWSET(BULK 'sales2016/', DATA_SOURCE = 'SilverData', FORMAT = 'PARQUET') AS [S16]
UNION ALL
SELECT *, 2017 AS SalesYear FROM OPENROWSET(BULK 'sales2017/', DATA_SOURCE = 'SilverData', FORMAT = 'PARQUET') AS [S17];
GO

-- ==================================================
-- 4. External Tables Creation (Gold Layer with 'Ext' Prefix & GoldData Source)
-- ==================================================

-- 1. Customer
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.external_tables WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('gold.ExtCustomer'))
    DROP EXTERNAL TABLE gold.ExtCustomer;
GO

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE gold.ExtCustomer
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'customer/',
    DATA_SOURCE = GoldData,
    FILE_FORMAT = SynapseParquetFormat
)
AS 
SELECT * FROM gold.Dim_Customer;
GO
